visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a simple centered layout with minimal graphic elements to a sophisticated full-bleed multi-column design featuring product screenshots, refined color blocking, and a cohesive system of decorative geometric accents. The visual complexity and polish increased substantially while maintaining a consistent color palette of green, blue, and pastel tones.
